assessment.basis: Conditional parameter agreement under both the combined-error comparison and numerical similarity screen; source confidence conventions remain explicit, and unknown source confidence or shared-data covariance does not become a formal confidence test or author-workflow reproduction.
qualifications: Every compared free coefficient passes the combined-error comparison and numerical similarity screen. The source explicitly reports two-sigma parameter widths; dividing those widths by two before combining with reconstruction standard errors also passes. The printed-source-width-only cutoff is not required for this parameter-agreement scope. Original weights, calibration covariance and author workflow remain unrecovered; shared-data cross-fit covariance is unknown. Existing reconstructed errors retained; no source confidence convention inferred. Earlier audit statement (superseded only as to missing reconstruction uncertainty and the resulting numerical label): Complete source-scope table check with unresolved fitting details: all seven I4/mcm Table 1 rows are used, K0-prime is fixed at 4, and the reported Ye et al. Pt pressures are retained. The source does not publish pressure uncertainties, residual direction, weights, fit software, unrounded inputs, or covariance. The generic fit therefore uses an errors-in-variables objective with one-sigma volume errors propagated from the table's two-sigma lattice errors; the dedicated reproduction also reports unweighted pressure- and volume-residual sensitivity fits. Those diagnostics do not define a replacement EOS, and the classification is capped at similar because statistical parity cannot be established without the source weighting and pressure-error model. See docs/literature-reproductions/uncertainty-reconstruction.md for the complete conditional uncertainty budget.

Usage recommendation: Use the unchanged published 300 K Vinet parameterization for qualified comparison in its measured 28.824-62.477 GPa range. V0 is an extrapolation and K0' is fixed at 4. Retain the reported 2-sigma lattice and parameter errors without inventing pressure errors or source weights. P4/mmm refinements are parallel structural diagnostics, not additional independent fit observations.

parameter_provenance.parameters: EOS discussion and Table 2 report V0=46.3(1) A3 on the one-formula-unit normalized basis and K0=223(6) GPa, with K0'=4.0 fixed.

parameter_provenance.volume_conversion: V0 multiplied by four for the conventional I4/mcm Z=4 card basis: 46.3*4=185.2 A3; uncertainty 0.1*4=0.4 A3.
parameter_provenance.phase: Rietveld refinement identifies tetragonal I4/mcm with octahedral rotation about c.
parameter_provenance.weights: The source does not identify the fitted residual variable, numerical weights, fit software, or covariance convention. Table 1 gives no pressure uncertainties; its lattice-parameter parentheses are 2-sigma. The reproducibility audit therefore reports unweighted-pressure and propagated-volume-uncertainty sensitivity fits without asserting either as the source objective.
